name: Action Score
brief: An action cue built on a driving ostinato in the low strings, with a hybrid of big hand drums and a tight modern kit underneath and short, hard brass punches on top. The rhythmic cells alternate short notes with a long one, so the pulse always leans forward. Harmony is phrygian or natural minor and moves by the flat second and the flat seventh. Write it as a trailer or game cue: a quiet pulse, a build where the ostinato enters, a hit section where brass answers the strings, then a cutoff. Tempo sits between 90 and 140, default 132. Articulations change on purpose: sustain for the swells, staccato and spiccato for the pulse, marcato for the punches.
neverDo: Quote or paraphrase an existing film cue, theme or trailer sting.
Leave the ostinato running at one dynamic for the whole cue; build it by adding layers and by changing articulation.
Put the brass punches and the ostinato on the same beat every bar without a rest.
Use an unlicensed sample, a leaked library or an unknown-origin drum break.
Close with a copied stinger; end on an original cutoff or a held low note.

bass.approach: Low strings play a sixteenth-note ostinato in short, short, long cells, accented on the first note of each beat. The flat second leans in on the last bar of each phrase.

voicings: Open fifths in the low strings
Brass in unison or octaves for the punches
Upper strings holding a sustained minor triad over the pulse

habits: Start with the pulse alone, then bring in the ostinato bar by bar.
Answer each string phrase with a brass punch on the off-beat.
Strip the texture to the low drums for one bar before the biggest hit.
End on a cutoff with silence, not a decaying tail.

listeningNotes: A low-string ostinato of short and long cells holds one pitch centre for most of the cue.
Articulation contrast is clear: sustained swells, then staccato or spiccato pulse, then accented brass punches.
Drums are a low hand-drum layer with a tight kit, and they thin out before the biggest hit.
Harmony stays phrygian or natural minor and moves by the flat second and flat seventh.
The ending is a cutoff, with no copied sting.
